title: TBI and a message for my Granny
content: Four years ago, I was driving home from work when I was rear-ended. I was struck so hard that the driver's side shock was ejected and it hit me in the head. The driver's side rear tire hit the back of my seat. In all I had a TBI, 4 broken vertebra, 6 broken ribs, punctured lung, and a stopped heart. I was called in as a fatality. During this time I had an entire conversation with my grandfather who had been dead 21 years. This is the only thing I remember from my accident. The only thing I remember from my 4+ week hospital stay was telling my granny that papaw said he'd "be waiting". She died less than a month later.
